sentences.text: Notice be made returnable within six weeks.
In the meantime, Registry is directed to call for the record of the Claims Tribunal.
Also heard on I.A. No.6188 of 2025, an application under Order 41 Rule 5 read with Section 151 of the CPC for stay of execution of the impugned award.
Learned counsel for the appellant / Insurance Company submits that the case involves a head-on collusion between the two vehicles.

He further submits that, pursuant to accident, an FIR was lodged against the truck and not the Scorpio, which is the vehicle insured by the appellant /
Insurance Company.

He submits that negligence of the driver of the insured vehicle has not been proved before the Claims Tribunal Since the application for compensation was filed under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, it was essential for the claimants to establish the negligence of the driver of the insured vehicle.

Considering the above, the execution of the impugned award dated 2 MA-5808-2025 30/04/2024 passed in MACC No.237/2021 is hereby stayed till the next date of hearing, subject to payment of 50% of the awarded amount before the Claims Tribunal within a period of 4 weeks from today.
(PAVAN KUMAR DWIVEDI) JUDGE Anushree Tata A.I.G. General Insurance Co.Ltd. vs Smt.Khanna on 6 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15181916/
